subject: Ciências Humanas e Sociais Aplicadas
description_pt: Utilizar as linguagens cartográfica, gráfica e iconográfica, diferentes gêneros textuais e tecnologias digitais de informação e comunicação de forma crítica, significativa, reflexiva e ética nas diversas práticas sociais, incluindo as escolares, para se comunicar, acessar e difundir informações, produzir conhecimentos, resolver problemas e exercer protagonismo e autoria na vida pessoal e coletiva.

components.description_pt: Aplicar linguagens cartográficas e gráficas para comunicar e analisar fenômenos sociais e espaciais
components.description_en: Apply cartographic and graphic languages to communicate and analyze social and spatial phenomena
components.cc_component_description: Interpret mathematical representations to communicate the results of a scientific investigation or design solution

components.description_pt: Usar tecnologias digitais de informação e comunicação de forma crítica e ética em práticas sociais e acadêmicas
components.description_en: Use digital information and communication technologies critically and ethically across social and academic practices
components.cc_component_description: Use digital tools and the Internet to produce and publish written products

components.description_pt: Produzir e compartilhar conhecimento usando diversos gêneros textuais e linguagens iconográficas de forma reflexiva
components.description_en: Produce and share knowledge using diverse text genres and iconographic languages in a reflective manner
components.cc_component_description: Write routinely in both short and extended time frames across a range of genres and disciplines

components.description_pt: Exercer autoria e agência na vida pessoal e coletiva por meio do uso ético de ferramentas e mídia digital
components.description_en: Exercise authorship and agency in personal and collective life through ethical use of digital tools and media
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the effectiveness of digital media choices in supporting a presentation's purpose

cc_matches.description: Use mathematical representations to describe and/or support scientific conclusions and design solutions.
Use technology, including the Internet, to produce, publish, and update individual or shared writing products in response to ongoing feedback, including new arguments or information.

Write routinely over extended time frames (time for research, reflection, and revision) and shorter time frames (a single sitting or a day or two) for a range of discipline-specific tasks, purposes, and audiences.

Make strategic use of digital media (e.g., textual, graphical, audio, visual, and interactive elements) in presentations to enhance understanding of findings, reasoning, and evidence and to add interest.
